work.description: The alphabetical index to the original Catholic Encyclopedia (New York: Robert Appleton Company, 1907-1912), as New Advent delivers it. New Advent publishes two indexes per initial letter and they are not the same document: an abridged page at /cathen/<letter>.htm, which states above its first entry that it "represents only a tiny fraction of articles available on the New Advent website", and an unabridged page at /cathen/<letter>-ce.htm, which the abridged one links to as the "full index" and which carries no limitation sentence - and no positive attestation of completeness either. Registered as a work of its own because the index belongs to no numbered volume, and because a chronology gap row's evidence can be the ABSENCE of an entry from the fullest of these pages, bounded by that page and correctable, never a claim that the encyclopedia carries no such article anywhere.
work.title: The Catholic Encyclopedia, alphabetical index
